title: Chicken piccata
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine or chicken broth
steps: Season and flour the cutlets. Shake off extra.
Sear in oil and 1 tbsp butter until golden, 2–3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Deglaze pan with wine. Add capers and lemon; simmer 2 minutes. Whisk in remaining butter.
Return chicken to the pan, coat in sauce, and finish with parsley. Serve with pasta.
